Validate only eight exact decorative imported source owners (400 triangles) and the separately named 12-triangle hull before retirement. Preserve every unrelated array and collision shape/state/pose. The original layout, assembler and shipping glTF remain unchanged.
All finishes are existing catalogue keys/maps. Programme lettering stays Label3D. Passive inspection stock grants no new input, maintenance, electrical or circuit capacity authority.

Native connected/positive closed stocks, assembly joins, strict physical UVs/tangents, actual floor contacts, all remaining source and eight accepted Photo libraries, imported ownership, ordinary COUNTY LEAGUE E/Escape, reconstruction and rendered composition remain required. This plan grants no runtime or human acceptance. Four other receiving chassis, frontal access, light/darkroom, services and whole-building acceptance remain open.
